Library

Yinyang files and shared updates

This guide owns the file and update contract for the maintained Yinyang package. The collection is Prometheus2Heraclitus; this complete member lives under skills/yinyang/. Its references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ are supporting resources, not independent Skills. Obtain the complete directory from the public repository and expose it through the consumer's actual Skill mechanism. The website is a reading surface; repository cloning and GitHub's native ZIP preserve complete source.

Yinyang is one developed philosophy and formation method. Readers can adopt it, combine selected resources, or create a different work. The example and commons essay develops that invitation. A philosopher's thought may inform a framework; it cannot replace the account of the actual user. This guide's five-account and common-update contract applies to full adoption of the maintained Skill. Reading its philosophy or borrowing a selected method does not by itself adopt that contract or require a personal philosophy project.

Common and situated content

Distributed and situated copies share byte-identical common content. Permanent writing guidance has six files: five account guides under references/formation/ and references/revision-guide.md, with complete Chinese editions. A private situated version adds the following fixed five accounts; public distribution contains neither these files nor placeholder accounts.

Fixed situated slot Responsibility
references/situated/orientation.md Adopted philosophy, values, and direction.
references/situated/person.md Grounded understanding of the actual person.
references/situated/counterpart.md Actual model and wanted contribution.
references/situated/relationship.md Joint activity, correction, and division of work.
references/situated/environment.md Realization through the actual environment.

Person, counterpart, and relationship remain three modeling objects. Orientation supplies adopted interpretive and evaluative direction; environment explains realization. The five are not all psychological models. The Philosophy and models routes each account to its permanent guide, which remains available after adoption.

Together with the common revision guide, these make six working files to maintain. The guide itself changes when practice reveals a better way of revising the arrangement. It explains the connected refresh of personal support, accounts, Skills, and environment, including webpage preview and publication sequencing. It belongs to the common package, with a full Chinese edition, and adds no sixth private portrait. The entrypoint includes it in the initial reading so a consuming model can maintain the arrangement it uses.

Adoption requires forming all five accounts from relevant authorized material and organizing their necessary private support. The model carries this writing; the user need not maintain files personally. Explicit unknowns can be honest situated content. Unchanged templates, a copied portrait, or an invented person do not constitute a formed version. Check coherence, grounding, reachable evidence, and the conversational model's ability to read and use the accounts at its actual entrypoint. Later revisions need change only affected content.

references/personal/sources.md is the actual private evidence entrance, supporting all five accounts rather than becoming another core account. The public evidence guide supplies its method. Further references/personal/ material retains useful private support and topical provenance. Filenames follow actual evidence; there is no universal list or required empty companion for every essay. Originals and extended history can remain with existing owners, reached through access-bounded references. Keep one authored philosophy: a private companion links to its common argument and retains the private evidence, rather than reproducing a second theory.

Everything outside the entire references/situated/ and references/personal/ trees is common: the entrypoint, reader editions, methods, essays, diagrams, reading map, administration, scripts, and OpenAI YAML adapter. The shared GitHub package owns this content. The entrypoint owns initial reading; design and revision connects the writing objects. Their six guides own actual directions; environmental realization belongs to the environment guide.

Project common changes

scripts/sync-common.py checks common source projection by default. With --apply, it projects common files into the target, preserving everything under both private trees, including additional files and links. It does not traverse or inspect their contents. It does not infer a person, export private files, or publish to a runtime.

Start a new situated version from a complete shared copy, then form its private accounts. Compare explicit package directories:

python3 /path/to/shared/yinyang/scripts/sync-common.py \
  --source /path/to/shared/yinyang --target /path/to/situated/yinyang

Add --apply to copy changes, then run the comparison again. Unmatched target files and common-path symlinks stop copying; inspect ownership rather than silently deleting them. Existing local or private Web owners install and publish the projected source, followed by actual-consumer readback.

Earlier packages mixed public guidance and private content at references/{encounter,models,relationship,usage,sources}.md. The projector refuses either package with any of these paths before changing files. Their owner first redistributes actual meaning into the five new accounts and private evidence index, preserves unique support, and retires the old paths. The old encounter can contain orientation and relationship, and the old relationship both counterpart and joint activity: a mechanical rename cannot complete this semantic migration. Retain any useful private references/personal/README.md substance at the appropriate private owner; the whole personal tree is protected.

Common parity preserves one recipient-local discovery exception: when the target's single-line SKILL.md description already begins with 用户自制：, the projector retains that prefix while replacing its substantive wording from the common source. An unmarked target stays unmarked. Every other common byte and file mode remains source-owned; the public package does not assign itself recipient-relative authorship.

This parity applies to copies choosing continuing common updates. If you replace the philosophy or organization independently, keep that work at its own source and maintain its coherent references. Do not project this common package over it, even if it retains the five-slot format.

Authors of other works can change the number and organization of accounts and the philosophy. The maintained Yinyang implementation keeps this fixed five.

Personal and public boundaries

Personal accounts remain private even when formalized or written for models. Private quotations, biography, psychological and health records, relationship narratives, account information, private paths and conversation identifiers, and unpublished manuscripts stay with their actual owners. General abstraction does not authorize public links that reconstruct private sources.

Return only authorized reusable insights to the collection. Yinyang original material uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; other independent members retain their own MIT licenses. Follow the collection guide and the actual publication owner for permissions, attribution, and source review. A private adaptation need not be published.
